+title: Fix the integration-gate test so the suite can run with the gate on
+---
+## What
+
+`Tests/FoundationModelsRankerTests/ExamplesSmokeTests.swift:171`
+
+```swift
+#expect(ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment[foundationModelsRankerIntegrationEnvVar] == nil)
+```
+
+The test "The gate is off when the opt-in environment variable is absent" asserts on AMBIENT process state instead of controlling it. It passes only when `FOUNDATIONMODELSRANKER_INTEGRATION_TESTS` happens to be unset. Set the variable — which is the supported way to run the real-model tests — and this test fails:
+
+```
+✘ Expectation failed: ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment[...] == nil
+✘ Test run with 273 tests in 21 suites failed after 1.461 seconds with 1 issue.
+```
+
+So `FOUNDATIONMODELSRANKER_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 swift test` can never be green. That blocks running the suite against the on-device model at all, including for coverage measurement.
+
+This defect was introduced by task `^20d9zdp`, which added the test when it moved the gate symbols into `Demo.swift`. Its intent was sound — cover the moved gate — but the assertion it chose reads the environment rather than injecting it.
+
+Fix by making the test independent of ambient state. Options, in order of preference:
+
+1. Test the gate's LOGIC rather than the process environment. If `isFoundationModelsRankerIntegrationEnabled` were expressed over an injectable lookup (a `[String: String]` parameter defaulting to `ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment`), both the on and off cases become plain unit tests with no ambient dependency. This is the only option that covers BOTH states.
+2. Gate the test itself with `.enabled(if: !isFoundationModelsRankerIntegrationEnabled)`, so it self-skips when the variable is set. Honest, but it then never runs in the very configuration that matters.
+
+Option 1 changes a source file in `Examples/FullMontyCore/Demo.swift`. That is acceptable here: the change is to make the seam testable, which is the point.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `FOUNDATIONMODELSRANKER_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 swift test` reports zero failures.
+- [ ] `swift test` with the variable unset still reports zero failures.
+- [ ] Both gate states — on and off — are covered by a test that does not depend on the ambient environment.
+- [ ] `isFoundationModelsRankerIntegrationEnabled`'s real default still reads the process environment, so `Examples/FullMonty` and the gated tests behave as before.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] The gate returns `false` for an environment dictionary with no entry for the key.
+- [ ] The gate returns `true` for an environment dictionary that has the key, including when its value is the empty string, since the current implementation tests only for presence.
+- [ ] A test asserts that `AgentSessionDispatchTests`'s gated test and `Examples/FullMonty` both read the same environment-variable name, so the two cannot drift apart.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with the variable set AND unset. State both runs in the report.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #coverage-gap #bug
\ No newline at end of file
